mapper.select: SELECT id, project_code, project_name, opportunity_id, customer_id, customer_name, business_dept_id, project_type, project_level, pm_id, pm_name, sponsor_id, sponsor_name, estimated_amount, budget_amount, planned_start_date, planned_end_date, duration_days, stage, current_gate, description, business_case, risk_assessment, workflow_id, tenant_id, created_by, created_at, updated_by, updated_at, deleted FROM pmis_project_initiation WHERE project_code = #{code} AND deleted = 0 LIMIT 1
mapper.update: UPDATE pmis_project_initiation SET stage = #{stage}, current_gate = COALESCE(#{gate}, current_gate), updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted = 0
mapper.select: SELECT stage, COUNT(1) AS cnt, COALESCE(SUM(budget_amount), 0) AS budget FROM pmis_project_initiation WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND deleted = 0 GROUP BY stage
SELECT COUNT(1) FROM pmis_project_initiation WHERE stage = #{stage} AND tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND deleted = 0

SELECT i.id AS id, i.project_code AS projectCode, i.project_name AS projectName, i.customer_name AS customerName, ( SELECT c.contract_name FROM pmis_project_contract c WHERE c.initiation_id = i.id AND c.deleted = 0 ORDER BY c.id ASC LIMIT 1 ) AS contractName, i.project_type AS projectType, i.stage AS stage, i.pm_name AS pmName, i.created_at AS createdAt, i.updated_at AS updatedAt FROM pmis_project_initiation i WHERE i.deleted = 0 AND i.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND ( to_tsvector('simple', coalesce(i.project_name, '') || ' ' || coalesce(i.customer_name, '') || ' ' || coalesce(i.pm_name, '') || ' ' || coalesce(( SELECT c.contract_name FROM pmis_project_contract c WHERE c.initiation_id = i.id AND c.deleted = 0 ORDER BY c.id ASC LIMIT 1 ), '') ) @@ plainto_tsquery('simple', #{keyword}) ) ORDER BY ts_rank( to_tsvector('simple', coalesce(i.project_name, '') || ' ' || coalesce(i.customer_name, '') || ' ' || coalesce(i.pm_name, '') || ' ' || coalesce(( SELECT c.contract_name FROM pmis_project_contract c WHERE c.initiation_id = i.id AND c.deleted = 0 ORDER BY c.id ASC LIMIT 1 ), '') ), plainto_tsquery('simple', #{keyword}) ) DESC, i.id ASC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}

SELECT COUNT(1) FROM pmis_project_initiation i WHERE i.deleted = 0 AND i.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND ( to_tsvector('simple', coalesce(i.project_name, '') || ' ' || coalesce(i.customer_name, '') || ' ' || coalesce(i.pm_name, '') || ' ' || coalesce(( SELECT c.contract_name FROM pmis_project_contract c WHERE c.initiation_id = i.id AND c.deleted = 0 ORDER BY c.id ASC LIMIT 1 ), '') ) @@ plainto_tsquery('simple', #{keyword}) )
